Fire separation of flats  
at Wang Fuk Court

- All walls between flats, or between flats and common areas: FRR > 60 mins

- Flat entrance door: FRR > 30 mins

- Kitchen door: FRR > 30 (some kitchen doors were replaced)

- Meter room and refuse room doors: FRR > 30 mins

- Wired glass windows (WGW s) on external wall of the lift hall and staircases: No FRR
